# Janitorial

Puts the Frontier janitor (`NFJanitor`) back on Caelestinus Central with two slots. Janitors spawn with the
janitor ship voucher, which buys the Bucket. Caelestinus skips the roundstart trash and puddle variation passes
(it gets `StationVariationHasRun`), so judges no longer start the round cleaning; mess comes from players.
